newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SICOM mulls changes in TSR20 rubber contract.
newsitem.headline: SICOM mulls changes in TSR20 rubber contract.

text.p: The Singapore Commodity Exchange (SICOM) is mulling changes in the terms of its TSR 20 rubber contract, the exchange's general manager said on Thursday.

Traders said the contract's trading currency will change to U.S. cents a kg from the current Singapore cents a kg and deliveries would be changed to FOB from award -- which requires inspection at SICOM.
"It (the changes) will be subject to SICOM board approval," Lim Toh Eng, SICOM general manager, said in an interview.
He declined to comment on speculation by traders that the the changes will be implemented from November 1.
Lim said SICOM expects to make an announcement on the matter this month.
